The solution would be to add proper error handling to the RxJava subscription by implementing an onError handler. This is a conceptual issue that can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the code. The fix would involve modifying the subscription to include error handling like `.subscribe(onNext, onError)` instead of just providing the onNext action. This is standard RxJava knowledge and doesn't require setting up a build environment to verify the correctness of the solution.
